name: Goalie chest and arm protector
definition: padded chest, shoulder and arm protector worn by the goalie in ice hockey.
notes: sold as Goalie Chest & Arm Protectors; Bauer, CCM, Vaughn, Warrior models by age group

name: Goalie pants
definition: padded pants with thigh and hip protection cut for the goalie in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Goalie sells Bauer Pro goalie pants, butterfly-cut with removable leg pillows

name: Goalie stick
definition: hockey stick with a widened paddle and large blade, made for the goalie in ice hockey.
notes: Senior Goalie Sticks category; CCM XF Pro, Tacks Pro, Vizion

name: Hockey neck guard
definition: cut-resistant collar or bib worn round the neck against skate blades in ice hockey.
notes: Sherwood neck guards: collar, bib and cut-resistant shirt versions; BNQ certified

name: Protective cup (athletic cup, box)
definition: rigid cup worn over the groin, alone or in a jock or jill supporter, to protect it in contact and ball sports.
notes: Shock Doctor cup sold under Jocks, Cups & Jills; TPO shell; cup separate from supporter

name: Hockey pant shell
definition: removable outer shell pulled over a hockey girdle to make full hockey pants.
notes: Ice Hockey Pant Shells category; Bauer shell fits over Bauer pants and girdles

name: Skate guard
definition: hard or soft guard fitted over an ice-skate blade to protect it off the ice.
notes: Howies Hockey Skate Guards: terry cloth guards protecting blades off ice

name: Hockey shooting pad
definition: slick synthetic sheet laid on the floor for practising stickhandling and shooting off the ice.
notes: Winnwell shooting pad, HDPE 40x24 in, simulates ice for shooting and stickhandling

name: Clip stick
definition: telescopic pole with a clip head that pre-clips a quickdraw or the rope to a bolt from below.
notes: Pongoose Climber 550+ telescopic clipstick clips quickdraws into bolts and rope into quickdraws

name: Cycling jersey
definition: close-fitting top with a full or part zip and rear pockets made for riding a bicycle.
notes: Endura jersey: cycling jersey, full zip, three rear pockets; Decathlon sells LeBram maillots

name: Wash-off face mask
definition: cream, clay, gel or peel mask spread on the face and rinsed off after a set time.
notes: Wash Off Masks category: clay, mud, enzyme, gel masks from many brands

name: Self-tanner
definition: lotion, mousse, drops or spray that tans the skin without sun, usually by DHA.
notes: Lucy Bee self-tan drops and mousse tan by DHA; spray and lotion not shown

name: Styling cream
definition: leave-in cream worked through hair to define, smooth or hold a style.
notes: Hair Styling Creams category, 109 items: leave-in creams defining curls or smoothing
